label: The stack and control: counterspells, "can't cast", timing restrictions, flash grants, phasing, morph, surge, spree, gaining control, cards from outside the game

cards.name: Silence
gaps: Your opponents can't cast spells this turn.

cards.name: Clever Concealment
gaps: Any number of target nonland permanents you control phase out. (Treat them and anything attached to them as though they don't exist until your next turn.)

cards.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
gaps: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast it, counter that spell.
Sacrifice Boromir: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
The Ring tempts you.

cards.name: Grim Haruspex
gaps: Morph {B} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, draw a card.

cards.name: Rebuff the Wicked
gaps: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.

cards.name: Bilbo's Gambit
gaps: Gift a Treasure (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Treasure token before its other effects. It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Return target spell to its owner's hand.
If the gift was promised, players can't cast spells this turn.

cards.name: Overwhelming Denial
gaps: Surge {U}{U} (You may cast this spell for its surge cost if you or a teammate has cast another spell this turn.)

cards.name: Render Silent
gaps: Its controller can't cast spells this turn.

cards.name: Refute
gaps: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Timely Ward
gaps: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if it targets a commander.
Enchanted creature has indestructible.

cards.name: Cunning Wish
gaps: You may reveal an instant card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Explosive Derailment
gaps: Spree (Choose one or more additional costs.)
+ {2} — Explosive Derailment deals 4 damage to target creature.
+ {2} — Destroy target artifact.

cards.name: Extrapolate the Impossible
gaps: You may reveal exactly two cards you own with different names from outside the game.
An opponent chooses one of them.
You put that card into your hand.

cards.name: Mob Rule
gaps: Choose one —
• Gain control of all creatures with power 4 or greater until end of turn.
Untap those creatures.
They gain haste until end of turn.
• Gain control of all creatures with power 3 or less until end of turn.
Untap those creatures.
They gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Pumpkin Bombs
gaps: {T}, Discard two cards: Draw three cards, then put a fuse counter on this artifact.
It deals damage equal to the number of fuse counters on it to target opponent.
They gain control of this artifact.

cards.name: Solarium Sentry
gaps: Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value 2 or less, you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
gaps: Creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield have flash.
Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.

cards.name: Word of Seizing
gaps: Untap target permanent and gain control of it until end of turn.
It gains haste until end of turn.
